# Codex

> > Codex provides the fastest and most reliable blockchain data API with real-time access to 75M+ tokens, 700M+ wallets, and 80+ networks via GraphQL and WebSockets.

Codex serves trading apps, bots, and web3 platforms with enriched on-chain data. Notable customers include TradingView, Defined.fi, Sudoswap, and 0x. The platform emphasizes speed, accuracy, and multi-chain coverage for enterprise-grade blockchain infrastructure.

## Key Topics

- Codex API
- blockchain data
- real-time token data
- WebSockets
- GraphQL
- multi-chain support (80+ networks)
- trading bots and apps
- wallet analytics
- DEX data
- API rate limits
- web3 infrastructure
- Defined.fi
- TradingView integration
- cryptocurrency APIs
- on-chain analytics
